# Pass Three — Critique & Improvements

Awtsmoos reveals the hidden edge before the polished vessel can shine.

1. Never trust client-side price as charge authority.
2. Require idempotent purchase/claim operations.
3. Visually separate Peruta balance from product credits.
4. Make credit provenance explicit: free, earned, purchased, promotional.
5. Preserve user work when a paid action is required mid-flow.
6. Never imply purchase success while offline.
7. Keep purchased value non-expiring unless policy explicitly says otherwise.
8. Provide insufficient-balance recovery without losing context.
9. Keep game monetization non-pay-to-win.
10. Keep core utility useful before paid capacity upgrades.
11. Lazy-load commerce overlays outside critical rendering/game loops.
12. Respect reduced motion and high-contrast needs.
13. Minimum 44px primary touch targets and safe-area insets.
14. Keyboard/focus semantics for every purchase surface.
15. Receipt IDs and clear error recovery.
16. Analytics without sensitive project/content payloads.
17. Central price formatting and experimentation config.
18. Catalog schema validation.
19. Purchase state-machine and balance-race tests.
20. Screenshot checks at 360px/390px/tablet/desktop.
21. No dark patterns, fake scarcity or hidden depletion.
22. No promise of guaranteed revenue; optimize trust, conversion and retention with evidence.
23. Check user-modified files before each rewrite.
24. Full-file rewrites only after complete readback.
25. Split any touched source that exceeds the project line-size doctrine.
26. Maintain tabs in code indentation.
27. Re-read every touched file after writing.
28. Compare planned vs actual implementation and close deltas.
29. Document adapter coverage across apps/games.
30. Record every remaining product-specific UX gap honestly.
